objective: Cross-channel nightly intelligence. Preserve disagreement; never turn consensus into fact.

consensus_policy.agreement_rule: At least two distinct sources share the same non-UNKNOWN stance and no opposite stance is present.
consensus_policy.disagreement_rule: At least one BULLISH and one BEARISH source occur under the same issue key.
consensus_policy.fact_rule: Agreement is source consensus only; factual status still comes from independent evidence.
